entries.subject: Mashchenko DISC shape solution
entries.finding: Mashchenko’s DISC solution uses the paper’s stated geometric albedo 0.1. The CIGAR alternative remains viable; a familiar artist impression is not measured geometry.

entries.subject: Artist impressions as surface textures
entries.finding: NASA and ESO artist impressions are not surface data: telescopes measured only unresolved light.
entries.revisitWhen: Resolved imaging of the object exists.

entries.subject: Horizons fixed-epoch trajectory for position
entries.finding: The fixed-epoch Horizons heliocentric osculating trajectory and independent vectors set the position. The open conic is not a simulation of non-gravitational acceleration or a reconstruction of the object’s unknown origin.
